name: navigation
description: Places, directions, EV trip planning, and Tesla vehicle control — Google Maps plus a Tesla Fleet server (trip planning + live controls: lock, climate, charging), each on its own dedicated host behind Cloudflare Access. Supply the per-server Cloudflare Access service-token credentials to enable.

MAPS_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Maps — CF Access Client ID
MAPS_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: CF-Access-Client-Id for maps.loup-peluso.com (per-MCP service token; ends in .access).

MAPS_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Maps — CF Access Client Secret
MAPS_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: CF-Access-Client-Secret for maps.loup-peluso.com. Stored in the system keychain; maintainer copy SOPS-encrypted in secrets/cloudflare-access.sops.json.
